port_of: Emby.Server.Implementations + Jellyfin.Server.Implementations (the concrete manager/repository classes; ~46K LOC)
implements: the manager & repository traits defined in hermit-traits
dependency_rule: hermit-core may `use` ONLY hermit-traits, hermit-model, hermit-db, hermit-common, hermit-naming (+ externals sqlx/tokio/serde/serde_json/async-trait/thiserror/uuid/chrono/tracing). Sibling managers it needs at runtime (MediaEncoder, ImageProcessor, ProviderManager, SubtitleEncoder, SubtitleManager, TranscodeManager, AttachmentExtractor, LiveTvManager, ChannelManager) are held as `Arc<dyn Trait>` from hermit-traits (dependency injection) and composed at the Wave 8 root — hermit-core NEVER depends on hermit-mediaencoding/drawing/providers/livetv/hls.
stack: sqlx runtime queries over hermit-db's SqlitePool (QueryBuilder for the InternalItemsQuery translation), async-trait manager impls, in-memory concurrent state (RwLock/DashMap-style via std) for sessions/live-streams/scheduled-tasks.
key_findings: TranslateQuery is the load-bearing port: BaseItemRepository.TranslateQuery.cs (54K) + QueryBuilding.cs (24K) + Querying.cs (22K) + ByName.cs (14K) form the InternalItemsQuery -> SQL builder. In hermit-core this becomes a QueryBuilder-based translator over hermit-db; InternalItemsQuery (33K options file) and SourceType already exist in hermit-traits::options. This must be unit 1 and everything item-facing depends on it.

BaseItemRepository ctor deps => ItemTypeLookup, IServerApplicationHost, IServerConfigurationManager, IItemTypeLookup must exist before/with the repository. ItemTypeLookup (static kind->name tables) and the config manager are therefore pulled forward into unit 1.

The C# BaseItem/Folder/Video OOP behavior (SupportsX, IsVisible, GetPlayAccess, IsFolder, path/kind predicates) is NOT a class hierarchy here: it becomes a `kinds` module of FREE FUNCTIONS over hermit_model::data::BaseItemKind (supports_chapters(kind), supports_people(kind), is_folder(kind), is_visible(kind, user), etc.). LibraryManager/DtoService/ChapterManager/TrickplayManager/MediaSegmentManager call these. This module is a unit-1/unit-2 dependency of almost everything.

NO LocalizationManager TRAIT exists in hermit-traits (there is no `localization` module). The culture/rating/country data types live in hermit-model::globalization. Port LocalizationManager as a CONCRETE struct in hermit-core (minimal culture/iso6392/countries/ratings lookup over bundled data) with an inherent API; FLAG that a trait is missing from hermit-traits (belongs there for DI parity).

NO ScheduledTasks/TaskManager, BackupService, or QuickConnect-worker traits beyond what exists: QuickConnect HAS a trait (security.rs). ScheduledTasks and BackupService have no traits -> concrete minimal types (task registry, no real cron scheduler; backup deferred).

net.rs traits AuthorizationContext + AuthService are IN scope (port of Jellyfin.Server.Implementations/Security/AuthorizationContext.cs + the AuthService gate) and are First-Light-critical for request auth. The WebSocket traits (WebSocketConnection/Listener/Manager) are Session-adjacent (Emby/Session/SessionWebSocketListener.cs + WebSocketController.cs); the *listener/push* logic ports here (thin), but the actual socket upgrade is hermit-api (Wave 7) — implement WebSocketListener wiring minimally, leave the transport upgrade to the injected connection.

AuthenticationManager trait (security.rs) = Jellyfin.Server.Implementations/Security/AuthenticationManager.cs; the api-key/device-auth + DefaultAuthenticationProvider/DefaultPasswordResetProvider/InvalidAuthProvider live in the Users unit and feed UserManager.authenticate_user.

SessionManager.cs is the single largest impl (81K); DtoService.cs (64K) and LibraryManager.cs (146K) are the other giants. Sequence these late (after repositories + config + users + dto helpers exist) and expect them to be multi-file modules.

Repositories map 1:1: BaseItemRepository->ItemRepository, ItemPersistenceService->ItemPersistenceService, ItemCountService->ItemCountService, ChapterRepository->ChapterRepository, MediaStreamRepository->MediaStreamRepository, MediaAttachmentRepository->MediaAttachmentRepository, PeopleRepository->PeopleRepository, KeyframeRepository->KeyframeRepository, LinkedChildrenService->LinkedChildrenService, NextUpService->NextUpService. OrderMapper/FolderAwareFilterExtensions/BaseItemMapper are internal helpers of the query builder, not separate traits.

DI shape: every manager is stored behind Arc<dyn Trait>; hermit-core structs take their collaborators (repositories, sibling managers, config, paths, db pool) as Arc<dyn ...> constructor args so Wave 8 can wire the graph. No global singletons.

ordered_units.name: unit 1 — item repository + query translation (First-Light core)
ordered_units.notes: Foundation. Build a sqlx QueryBuilder-based translator over hermit-db for InternalItemsQuery (already ported in hermit-traits::options). Also port the `kinds` free-function module here (supports_x/is_folder/is_visible over BaseItemKind) since the query builder and counts need it. ItemTypeLookup is a pure static-table impl with no deps. Config manager (unit 3) is a ctor dep of BaseItemRepository but only for path/library options — inject as Arc<dyn ServerConfigurationManager>, so no code dep.

ordered_units.name: unit 2 — per-item sub-repositories
ordered_units.notes: Straightforward per-item row CRUD over hermit-db; each reuses the `kinds` helpers and (NextUp) the query translator from unit 1. NextUpService returns NextUpEpisodeBatchResult and is consumed by TvSeriesManager later.

ordered_units.name: unit 3 — config, system, paths, localization
csharp: ApplicationHost.cs (server-relevant host facts + URL builders only)
Localization/LocalizationManager.cs (+ countries.json / iso6392.txt / Ratings) => CONCRETE struct, NO trait (flagged)
ordered_units.notes: Config + paths are dependency roots for repositories, DTO, sessions, and external-data deletion. ApplicationHost is trimmed to ServerApplicationHost (ports/friendly-name/virtual-path expand/reverse/URL builders); the DI/plugin machinery is dropped. LocalizationManager is a concrete lookup over bundled culture data (minimal set) because hermit-traits has no localization trait — FLAG to add one.

ordered_units.name: unit 4 — users, auth, security, devices
ordered_units.notes: UserManager owns password hashing (via hermit-common crypto), policy/config, and providers. AuthorizationContext + AuthService parse/validate RequestContext -> AuthorizationInfo, resolving tokens against api-keys/devices/users; First-Light-critical for every authenticated endpoint. DeviceManager persists DeviceEntity/DeviceOptionsEntity and gates CanAccessDevice.

ordered_units.name: unit 5 — library manager, media sources, views, search, music
csharp: Library/LibraryManager.cs (146K; query/count/people/genres/delete/scan orchestration over unit 1-2 repos)
ordered_units.notes: LibraryManager delegates raw rows to unit 1-2 and orchestrates business logic; resolver/path/sort/named-view methods that need the un-ported OOP tree become free functions in a `library::resolvers` module. MediaSourceManager holds live-stream state (in-memory map) and injects Arc<dyn MediaEncoder>/Arc<dyn ProviderManager> for probing. Search/SimilarItems drop their provider registries (composed at Wave 8).

ordered_units.name: unit 6 — DTO assembly service
csharp: Dto/DtoService.cs (64K: BaseItemEntity + user-data + images + people -> BaseItemDto)
ordered_units.notes: The rich entity->BaseItemDto mapping deferred from Wave 3. Reads via LibraryManager/UserDataManager/ItemCountService, resolves images through injected Arc<dyn ImageProcessor>, honors DtoOptions field/image toggles, and uses the `kinds` helpers for per-kind DTO shaping. Depends on nearly everything below it.

ordered_units.name: unit 7 — session manager + websocket wiring
csharp: Session/SessionManager.cs (81K: session lifecycle, playback start/progress/stop, commands, capabilities)
Session/SessionWebSocketListener.cs + WebSocketController.cs (push loops; transport upgrade left to hermit-api)
ordered_units.notes: SessionManager holds in-memory SessionInfo state and reports playback to UserDataManager; message broadcast collapses to pre-serialized JSON payloads (object-safe). EventManager is the in-process publish seam used across managers. WebSocket listener/push ports thin; the injected WebSocketConnection performs actual I/O.

ordered_units.name: unit 8 — TV next-up + minimal/stub managers
csharp: Collections/CollectionManager.cs (MINIMAL — create/add/remove box sets over BaseItemEntity)
Chapters/ChapterManager.cs (MINIMAL — delegates to unit-2 ChapterRepository + kinds::supports)
Trickplay/TrickplayManager.cs (MINIMAL — metadata read/write only; tiling helpers deferred)
QuickConnect/* (QuickConnect trait; may return a pending SessionInfoDto envelope)
ordered_units.notes: TvSeriesManager is real (paginates NextUpService output to QueryResult<BaseItemDto> via DtoService). The rest are MINIMAL: implement the trait fully but thin, delegating to earlier repos where possible and returning empty/basic results for the un-ported OOP-tree behaviors. Note each deferral inline.

ordered_units.name: unit 9 — deferred subsystem stubs + scheduled-task registry
csharp: ScheduledTasks/TaskManager.cs + ScheduledTaskWorker.cs -> minimal task registry, NO real scheduler (concrete type, no trait)
FullSystemBackup/* -> BackupService DEFERRED (concrete no-op or omitted)
ordered_units.notes: STUB/NO-OP per scope. ChannelManager/SyncPlayManager/PluginManager/LyricManager satisfy their hermit-traits::stubs traits with empty/no-op bodies. LiveTvManager stub only registers Arc<dyn LiveTvManager> injection surface (real impl is hermit-livetv, injected at Wave 8) — if a local placeholder is needed it returns empty LiveTvInfo. ScheduledTasks is a concrete registry (register/list/run-now) with no cron loop. BackupService deferred.
